$comment: Prompts for this game: paper is generated with Image Gen; legacy wooden art is baked with Blender (render_assets.py).

island.prompt: A floating sky island: rocky brown underside tapering to a point with a few hanging vines, lush green grass on top, and on top a giant wooden tic-tac-toe board with chunky red X and blue O pieces, small bushes and a tiny red flag. Isometric 3/4 view, whole island visible.

paper.prompt: Seamless flat top-down warm ivory natural notebook paper (#f4eedf), subtle fibers and fine matte tooth, evenly illuminated. No lines, grid, marks, pen, hand, text, shadows, folds, edges or vignette. Generated with Image Gen for the paper-and-ink Caro board.
